reviews.review_description: Very impressed with the installation team's expertise and dedication to doing a good job.

Contact with all potential providers was good.Sales process was straight forward and clear. The selected provider, Perth Solar Force, were able to produce a system design for what I was looking for and with various rebates included the final configuration was affordable. Perth Solar Force were flexible on installation dates and the installers arrived when scheduled performed the work including the few adjustments that I had asked for when dealing with the Sales Rep. They work with me to place the battery storage in a location that met the necessary legislative and safety requirements as well as a location optimal for the household needs. They ensured the circuits I wanted in the event of a blackout would be powered by the batteries. The complete install took a couple of days for my two storey house, was not at all disruptive and provided a great end result.The Installers also ran through the operation of the system, shutdown and startup procedure, safety switches, documentation, ran through the various tests to confirm the system was fully operation for the various scenarios as designed and as required.It's only been a few weeks since installation and the system is working very well, the companion application is nice to use and informative. As to reliability I guess I see in 10-15 years time how it is still performing. If the equipment is as good quality as the installer I won't need to worry.Oh, and the cockatoo enjoyed having the installers around. I think they both found each other entertaining

Perth Solar Force's administration team have been great to deal with and were always very responsive. Whilst they are obviously very busy calls are always returned promptly with the required information shared.The install team likewise did a fantastic job and were great to deal with. I hadn't realised the amount of work involved in one of these installs and all three of them worked hard all day. The job that they did is very professional and like the top-notch tradesmen they clearly are they left a really tidy worksite once they had finished. I didn't envy them pulling cables in the roof and could hear how hard that was at times.Dealing with the sales side was also a pleasure. I am very happy with the equipment, it's ease of use and performance.I would not hesitate to recommend Perth Solar Force to anyone looking to have a solar system/battery system installed.

I had two of the three recommended companies visit our property to provide quotes. Both sales people were very professional, on time and prepared. Both provided options for our property and discussed the variables. We do have some large trees on the property which I value highly and wanted to keep, so things were not so straight forward. These trees grew to effectively block an old 2.2kW system on the garage roof and we wanted an upgrade. After many emails back and forth with both companies optimising a system, in the end I went with Perth Solar Force. They were able to supply a bigger than 10kW battery at a better price than the powerwall I was initially looking at and Tigo optimisers on each panel of a north (12 panels) and east (10 panels) facing system. Although the actual products are not in Finn’s top ten lists, they have as good a warranty as any and I was prepared to give them a go - hoping a top rated installer would not sell an inferior product. I wasn’t looking for a system with all the bells and whistles,  just something basic, reliable and would do the job.The installation team of four were on time on install day, though the weather conditions were not that favourable. Initial discussion on cabling between the house and garage, where the battery and inverter were installed, proved fruitful and together, we came up with a good solution for the conduits, which I can paint in future. I mostly left them to their own devices, just having a poke around from time to time. They did a very good job, dodging showers with battery installation, then back on the roof when showers cleared. I was left with a neat looking system on the house roof, tidy battery and inverter in the garage and the back up box installed near the main meter at the front of the house. The lead installer ran me through the basic operation of the system, shut down and start up procedures and an overview of the app used to monitor it. The system was installed and online in one day.Overall, very happy with the process from start to finish. Time will tell if the products go the distance without too many issues.

Perth Solar Force have provided exceptional service from from the initial sales enquiry to the installation and follow-up visits. Whilst I had a leak via a cracked tile following installation, all follow-up has been immediate and followed through until the leak was resolved. All of the staff who visited my premises were courteous and professional and were a pleasure to do business with.

Quoted a competitive price and they were the only company who could deliver exactly what I wanted. The installation was carried out in a timely manner and the crews were very tidy, clean and efficient. The communication was good, and they were quick to fix an issue with the app. Overall very happy with the process.

I’ve just had a GoodWe solar system put in by Perth Solar Force and I’ve been very impressed with them throughout the whole process.Presales: Glen was fantastic throughout the quoting process. With new state and federal rebates rolling out, the whole industry felt a bit chaotic—details kept changing and even some suppliers didn’t have the full picture. Glen stayed on top of it all, breaking down what incentives applied to my setup and how the timelines worked. On top of that, he fielded my mountain of “what if” scenarios and happily tweaked the proposal so I could compare options side by side. I never felt rushed, and nothing was too much trouble.Installation: The crew turned up on time, were friendly and professional, and talked me through placement options for the inverter, battery and cabling. They made sure I understood exactly what was going where and why. Bonus points for removing an old antenna and replacing a couple of cracked roof tiles that weren’t even near the array—completely unprompted.Finish: The workmanship is spoton. Conduit runs are straight, labels are clear and everything looks neat and intentional rather than “good enough.”All up, PerthSolar Force delivered a combination of expert advice, courteous installers and meticulous quality. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them.
Easy. Good salesperson. Professional. Competitive. Seamless. Punctual. Installers professional and tidy and efficient.

The company responded quickly SolarQuotes notification of our interest. Their sales rep provided clear advice, responded succinctly to our questions, and didn't try to sell us something we did not want. In a nut shell, he was very professional. The quote was received the same day and immediately accepted by us. The office team kept us advised throughout the process. The install team were spot on time, friendly, skilled, and tidied up afterwards.The SAJ battery is due to be installed in July (post Gov't rebate).Going forward, a water heat pump will be the final piece of the project.

Salesperson was informative and friendly took time to answer all my questionsThe install team were professional and informed me of what they were doing during the whole processChecked details with me and were able to adapt the layout of some of the panels after assessing the shade that was coming from a patio roofThey did all the rebate applicationsLet me choose where the panel went and showed me how to use the app and how to read the panelThe whole experience has been excellent

Neville from Perth Solar Force was in touch within hours of my request for a quote. He came around the very next day and was a pleasure to deal with. We planned out the system, including the placement of the panels on his laptop there and then.The installer guys were also fantastic. They got all 45 panels up on the roof on a rainy day.
Everything went very smoothly. nothing more to say...product as advertised
Friendly informative salesmanGood installation team Josh,Conner and CoreyThe crew did all grid connection work and helped me with the phone app
Very good they were very helpfulGreat company highly recommend

I'm very happy I went with Perth Solar Force.They're a well organised machine. Very nice sales person (Glen) who could came to my house to understand the awkward block re: shade and size. He put up with my back and forth and changing mind a few times, sending me multiple updated quotes and options. Thanks Glen.The installation team was similarly very professional, on time, efficient and produced a great result.Top marks all around for PSF.I'll definitely be using them when I get a battery.

The Sales person was amazing, they give me the feeling that they are trying to sell me a system for me. I did take the risk with a less well known Chinese system and there was a little pressure to go with SAJ.Between the acceptance of quote and install, the process got a little messy with additional information required that could have been collected when the sales person what at my house.There is also little guidance on where the inverter should be installed. The "Leave it to the day" attitude grates on people like me who want the installation team to have a clean run at anything they need. In my case an entire shelf had to move and I did require to discuss the inverter location before the installer were on site.Installation went smoothly, after I go things out of the way. Overall the installation team were great. They were typical trade messy and also left some screws lying around my garage, where my car usually goes. A few electrical things were also left unplugged (yes a minor thing).Guidance of the use of the system was excellent.Completion of all of the required utility requirements were done in a prompt fashion.

Sales quote was good, home visit with options and explanations. Installation very good by a young team, had to deal with difficult routing of cables but worked with me to come up with a good solution. Handover and app setup done by installer with me. Works well.

I have given the quality of the system 4 stars because it has only been installed a few weeks ago.  I don't yet know how it will perform in the future.The sales/quoting process was clear and professional and prompt.The installation was tidy & punctual.  The people who came to do the installation were polite.The company must have arranged the grid connection for me after the install.I don't have a charger for an electric car.  My job was for a simple solar panel connection on the roof.
Very professional the installers informed me of what they were doing step by step, worked very professionally and efficiently
Prompt honest sales person followed up on everything I asked, site inspection completed and awaiting installation.

Solar Force provided a great salesman that walked me through all options, as well as discussing the different systems available. After considering my power needs, I settle on good quality middle of the pack system that meet all requirements. The follow up service from the office was simple and the installers arrived on time and completed the job in about 3 hours. I purchased some 12 roof tiles in preparation for possible damages during the install. Did not require any as no roof tiles were damaged. System has been in for a few days and on average so far providing about 5kwh for most of the day. Will see how it goes after a full two monthly bill cycle comes in, but according to the calculations prior to installment I should see at least an 80% reduction in my bill.

Of the three quotes only Kevin from Solar Force immediately made an appointment for an onsite quote. He was great, super professional. The installers were punctual, polite, friendly, and answered all of my questions Very happy with the procedure from beginning to end with emails informing what the procedures were. A few weeks before install we were offered a panel upgrade worth $500 at virtually no extra cost ($15), so we got newer panels with the same generating power, with one less panel needed. A very minor issue was some post install confusing email communication, it was so minor just requiring me to call the office and ask a question about the STI transfer, easily sorted, and further communication to verify I was sorted, a text this morning advised me that was an ongoing issue with the installation and it be sorted within a few days, just expect another text/email, and the APP is showing excellent performance, overall its a 99.9% rating.
The sale rep was good, always happy to answer my questions.The installation was quick and good.
Deposit paid, installation to be conducted 4 - 8 weeks after moving in dateAttentive sales personFair (not the cheapest) pricingUse of in-house installersGood google reviews
Great service, installation and competitive prices on the quality products
Couldn't be happier with our new solar system. From the meeting to install was incredibly quick with minimal hassle. Highly recommend.

Prompt quotes and amendments, very amenable to changes after first quote accepted.  Arranged all matters re connection to grid and production monitoring. Minor delay in installation possibly due to long travel time. Technicians polite and efficient.

From the salesman coming out to quote, installation, after sales service as part was missing and they needed to come and fit it.  Then the wi-fi needed boosting from the inverter to the box and they will supply and fit the booster for us at extra cost but we could have purchased it ourselves and they fit free of charge.  We have an appointment for Wednesday 31st to have the booster fitted.  The company has been exceptional in their after sales service.

My system was installed back in Jan 2023 so I'm writing this review a while after the installation was completed. The initial quote and site survey were well organised and the team came prepared on the day of installation. I had limited space to install the system and had drawn up some plans, and the end result the team delivered was just what I had aimed for. There have been a couple of issues since with a failed wifi module and DC breaker, but Perth Solar Force replaced them promptly under warranty with no hassles. Everything has been running smoothly since so I'm happy to recommend them as the company has shown continued support for their systems.

I had a single phase 6kw solar system on my three phase house that i bought a couple years back. (don't know why it was the case, but that was what the previous owners had.) Especially after buying my first EV and spending most of my time out of my home during the day i decided to upgrade my system and get some batteries. Tom was the sales consultant and offered me plenty of options as well as recommending the best course of action based on what i was trying to do.with all the options i was presented, I ended up going with a SAJ 10kw 3 phase system with 25kwh of SAJ batteries as well. once i approved the quote the staff where quick to get my upgrade organized and approved for install.Though the Staff allowed for Two days for the upgrade/install of the new system. the team installing it managed to smash it out all in one day. The Team always kept me informed. explaining the processes at the start and asking me any questions they had along the way. once installed and they had registered the system. They showed me how to use the app and ran me through all the information i needed to know. they also assured me that at the end of the day, If their was any problems i could contact them for help and would either fix the issue remotely or send out someone out.Perth Solar force were a excellent company to deal with and I would happily recommend the whole team to anyone who asked,
Sales/quoting process was detailed an accessible. Not pushyInstallation went smoothly. Team was tidy, punctual and informativeCustomer service has been outstanding thus far.

Found the salesman was very down to earth and not pushy. He answered all our questions. We were convinced by the company’s promise of after sales service.Seems good value for money although I suppose only time will tell.The installers were very polite, there was an issue with the weather and one panel shattering but they returned the following week to finish the installation.
Sales was excellent and informativeInstallation quick and efficientJosh the electrician carefully explained the process and set up the system ready to go
I was just extremely impressed with Tom Ransome the sales person and the installer -Luke -electrician and supervisor. The team worked well and were very respectful.  Thankyou Perth Solar Force

- sales /quoting process, as we expected, honest and delivered promptly- installation went smoothly, live the place tidy and punctual.- the customer service is fantastic, explain the function's of the grid after the installation.

Not the cheapest nor most expensive but certainly easy to comprehend and attentive to detail.Took into account my needs and the aesthetic requirements as well as practical needs of the installation.There was an inevitable lag between placing the order and installation - good suppliers are busy, I get that - but on the day the friendly team arrived early and had the system up and running and producing power by 3pm. Very happy with their service and would recommend them to anyone looking for a solar system or Tesla charger. Looking forward to them returning to install my battery once we are both satisfied that the system supports it.

The company from start of the sales and process right through installation was very professional and organised including doing the grid connection and connecting us with the app on our phone and ipad.We would not hesitate to recommend this company at all.
Excellent company to deal with. Communication and arrival times very good.Perth Solar Force organised the grid connection.Highly recommended.

We are very happy with the service we received. So fast and efficient and a very quick response all round. From the first day with the consultant who was very informative and enthusiastic to having the solar installed was inside three weeks. Western Power changed our meter box within the 11 days we were quoted by Perth Solar Force. The team were on time to the minute when they came to install and were very tidy and polite.  We could not be happier. Would definitely recommend them.

Middle of the range for price, non pushy sales, high quality installation and fast installation.Only potential thing to pick is that the whole STC thing was explained fully to us, a third party dealer is involved.

Sales rep & quoting process was good, quick & included useful information.Installation was quick  - but they left before we could return home, so had no handover.Everything was organised, customer service is good.
Comprehensive quote options provided. Installation was troublefree . They turned up on time and everything looks good. Very helpful with grid installation. No negatives to report.

Salesman (Neville) came to our home and explained Solar systems in detail.  He spent at least an hour with us.  No pressure to sign up, left us to think about options.  Kept us informed along the way.Installers arrived on time, explained changes to plan due to roof complexities, did a tidy and thorough job, and explained how to use the system before leaving.
Perth Solar Force were professional from sales to installation and connection.

Perth Solar Force recommended and quoted on a system that was suitable for my needs. They didn't try to sell me anything I didn't really need and made the whole process very simple and easy to understand.Installation went very smoothly and the system has been running perfectly since. Highly recommended.
Very professional from the visit of sales person, through the office follow-up, to the actual installation: including good technical advice. A very good, easy experience.

Sales Process - I wanted the panels installed on the patio and carport but was aware the structures might not be suitable for the panel installation, however the quote proceeded with the installation on said structures.Installation - The boys arrived on time and were well mannered. After an inspection of the patio and carport they decided the panels would not fit on the patio and carport, as the sales person's plan indicated. Fortunately my workshop roof area was sufficient to accommodate all the panels and with 3 phase 20 amp wire connected to the main distribution board the panels and inverter were installed on the workshop.Customer Service - Everything was organised

Sales, Admin and installers all showed their expertise in the Solar industry.Removal of  the older Solar system and installation of the new system was well planned and completed in a reasonable time frame.We now have a new Solar and battery system that is of good quality and meets our expectations.The installers gave us a run down of the system and advised, if we have any questions or problems we can contact their company for assistance.
Salesman very nice to deal with. Installation team friendly and considerate.

Perth Solar Force were efficient from the start to finish.They were the only quoter to send someone to the house and he provided full details and explained all aspects. This was done within days of contact from Solar Quotes.They were not the cheapest quote but we felt comfortable with them and it was the best system for us plus an in-house installation team.The installation was prompt given Xmas and New Year period. The team arrived on time and communicated throughout the day with the issues as they arose. (Complicated roof & damaged consumption meter) All done in the day,  work was very neat and tidy and system working beautifully.Consumption meter arranged for following day.All in all very happy we chose Perth Solar Force.
Great process from obtaining the quotes through to installation. Staff all very friendly, polite and great communication.

Sales quoting process was straightforward and informative.  Quote was given promptly.Installation by Jack and Harry was efficient.  They were willing to answer questions and explain clearly how the system operated.  They cleaned up afterward the job was completed.  They were also punctual.Customer service excellent.  An electrician was sent around next day to check the system was working properly after a request was made by me.  They organised the grid connection after installation.

Five stars again!Perth Solar Force installed our rooftop solar three years ago and more recently installed batterie, a new inverter and an (externally supplied) charging system of our new EV.A few weeks ago the charger developed a fault. PSF came out immediately, diagnosed the fault, and liaised on our behalf with the supplier to replace the unit under warranty. They ten came back last week and installed the new unit and arranged for the cost to be covered by the supplier.All round, simply excellent customer service.

Great sales/quoting process.Installation was very polite and prompt, generally tidy (some littering on the roof - not of concern), and some minor damage to gutters that would have been nice to have been told about rather than me finding out by myself.

Sales man was not pushing me to go bigger, gave me good advice on the best unit for someone in my position. Service men were very good and helpful, punctual, polite, looked professional well organised they had already got the information required which made it easy for me.

Knowledgable sales person. Prompt quote and replies to questions. Installation personnel, friendly enough. Although installers didn't square roof brackets to frames. It just didn't look right to me .... am I over fussy? System works. All paperwork and grid connection arranged by installer.

There are so many options for panels and inverters it can do your head in - and most offer the same or similar options.The sales process from PSF was clean and simple - good communication, prompt arrival, no "bull" approach or up-selling.Installation was on time and went very efficiently. Team leader was very accommodating and helpful.Grid connection was immediate - basically everything just happened.

John was great to deal with throughout the quote process, very knowledgeable and transparent about what we required. He was also very helpful with providing further quotes so that we could find a system that met our budget.The installers were on time, polite and hard working. Unfortunately Mother Nature had other plans and they had to delay completion of the job due to rain.The office contacted us the next day to have the job completed but we were not home. They were able to attend to complete the job a week later and we have not been disappointed.Everything was organised and connected ready to go with no stress.It is still early days but so far so good.

We are very happy with our choice of solar. Spending time on Solar Quotes first really helped understand what we were looking for and what to ask.We were scared off from solar a few years back after getting the run around from a lot of cowboys and not knowing who to trust.We had 3 quotes from Solar Quotes and one from another provider and went with Perth Solar Force. Great sales consultant in Kevin. Explained everything with no BS great follow up when I had more questions after our consult. Price was in the middle, but I was sold on service, the after sales support, and the fact that everything was in house. Big team of employees with sales, installation and support all looked after by employees in house.Dealing with team in the office to schedule installation and payment was super easy, flexible and friendly.Can’t fault Matt and the installation team. Efficient, thorough and friendly. Not a scrap of anything left onsite.Great little app to track what we’re generating.Such a great experience and so glad that we found Solar quotes which led us to Perth Solar Force. Looking forward to my next power bill!

Every step of the way was easy and seamless, from the sales people who explained everything well and answered our questions, the office staff who were friendly and efficient and the installation team who were extremely tidy, efficient and did a great job. I highly recommend Perth Solar, they just gave me a feeling of comfort and that I was in the right hands.
The whole process of getting a quote to installation has been very smooth. We have had the system for a few days now so yet to see how our hills change. Perth Solar Force were fantastic to deal with.

Like many here, I did a fair amount of research into both the various products and installers. I had undertaken a detailed review of my usage to determine the optimal panel, inverter and battery combination - this was also done to provide guidance and an equal/common system for all installers to quote so I could determine the best value for money. The added complexity was the inclusion of a Zappi EV charger was to make best use of excess solar rather than sending back into the grid for a pitiful return.I approached five different installers for quotes. Three never bothered meeting in person and were quite happy to trash-talk the competition. I also felt they were just 'suits' and pushy sales people. The other two met in person and were very learned (being either an electrical engineer or electrician). Perth Solar Force (PSF) took the time to understand my requirements and desired outcomes of the whole system. Over the course of two months we negotiated back and forth over the system technicals but never once I feel pushed to make a decision. The salesperson was polite, sought specialist advice as required, and was willing to not just quote the system I wanted but also provided alternate options. In the end I went with my original configuration and we were able to maximise the panels to suit the hybrid inverter (originally proposed 7 kW but opted for 9.13 kW).Following quote acceptance, I was kept updated on Western Power's application (took longer due to the battery). A detailed pre-installation inspection was conducted and the PSF team advised of certain challenges and options for ducting; involving me in the process and decision making.The actual installation was a breeze. The lead electrician was on site the whole time and took time to thoroughly explain each step over the 1.5 day installation, including system operation at handover. All works were done incredibly neatly with virtually no trace left of rubbish left behind. The other electricians were very professional, prompt and a pleasure to have at my home.The EV charger was installed on a separate day due to availability of parts.Throughout the entire process, the customer service at PSF was flawless. Everything from sales to technical/electricians, to accounts and admin - all staff were very polite and professional.The system's performance over the past two months has met or exceeded my expectations in terms of efficiency. In the two months since installation, the solar/battery has resulted in my home being ~88% self-sufficient which, considering some colder/cloudy days in June, I expect to only improve in spring/summer. Of the 1.2 MWh generated so far, I have self-consumed just over half with the remainder fed back to the grid but am looking forward to utilising this excess once my EV once it arrives (free 'fuel').Would not hesitate to recommend PSF - and already have to work, family and friends.
Great service could not hope for better.Thanks Perth solar force

Salesperson was thorough taking time to answer all questions and provide clear information.Installers were on time, polite and respectful. They left the premises clean. System was explained.As system only just installed cannot truely comment on system quality at this time

All of the potential suppliers were polite, punctual and helpful, and I'm sure all of them would have provided a good service. Our chosen installer originally scheduled our installation about 8 weeks after we accepted their quote, but actually came within 3 weeks because they got a cancellation. As it happened the weather was awful when they turned up and they were unable to proceed on that day, but they came a couple of days later and did the whole job. Everything proceeded well, and my place was left clean and tidy apart from a couple of tiny bits of insulation that I found later.
Sales Quote was Great , every think works out what was said.

The sales/quoting process was honest and competitive.The installation was fuss free, Polite, tidy and punctual.Customer service had some challenges in relation to inverter software setup. The default settings did not match Australian Standards (as the SMA inverter is from Europe) but they fixed it 100% and reset the defaults.I have recommended SolarForce to a few friends that have had the same positive experience that I have dad.

The entire process with Solar Force was professional on their part and easy for me.Glen turned up on time, answered every question, was honest about the expected returns from the system and the new rules around solar.The back office crew were efficient and helpful, as there are a few forms etc to fill in and preparations to make for the install.The install team were punctual, tidy and polite, and made sure everything was spot on before they left and that I knew how to work the app.Solar Force wasn't the cheapest quote I received, but their main selling point for me was that they have been around for many years and all the feedback indicated that on the rare occasion something goes wrong with a system, they will come and fix it with minimal hassle.
sales person visited the home which was good. He didn't try and push us to a bigger system

Solar force was only company to contact me. Their interactions with me was as what I expect from a good company which was refreshing these days. Installation was top class by the crew that came out. My one down size in service is because I received  a unidentified TEXT message to sign a stc form? On opening the form there was NO identifier on there that told me this was Solar Force which is the only identity I have been dealing with? I had to call Solar force and request if it was from them that they needed to send the form to me again so I could verify this was no scam. That was a step that detracted from an otherwise good experience.

1) The sales/quoting process was very efficient and in line with what I asked for.2) The installers were exactly on time, efficient and polite and there were no problems at all during the whole installation process.3) I had an existing 5 kw solar system with a single phase grid connection. The new system has a 3 phase grid connection and also in-house consumption metering. There was no problem at all, the installing company organised everything and I had nothing to do with the whole process.

The original quote was similar to 4 other quotes but with better rated products. While considering the quotes they came back with a special offer which did the deal. The installers showed up on time and completed the install with no issues. Good communication throughout.

The quote/sales process from the start to finish was smooth and pricing was reasonable and even the installer try to match any quotes/discounts given by other supplier.Installation went really well, the team were polite, punctual and even tidying up the loose materials which was fantastic.Solar Force organise grid connections after install and customer service was excellent. The office team even got back to me with any queries I had in quick time.

We had our system installed 5 years ago and received great savings on our electricity from day 1.  Installation was professional and on time.  Unfortunately, the inverter stopped working and required replacing.  Montanna and the team went above and beyond to assist me throughout the whole process and we have had a new inverter replaced.  Montanna is responsive to every email and request and all staff have been pleasant and professional.  Thank you.  Highly recommended.

The solar system was installed over a week ago. The agreement was, the installer had to remove old disconnected solar hot water system. Installer say it was to heavy to remove. Emailed and spoke to Perth Solar Force. Was told someone would be in touch shortly. Still waiting!A contractor attended Thursday morning to change power meter. Was told he couldn't do it because there is asbestos behind the meter. Surely the installer wouldn't have communicated this to the contractor? Obviously not!I contacted Perth Solar Force, got the same response, someone will be in touch shortly. Still waiting.Not impressed with Perth Solar Force!

Could not fault this company. Excellent communication throughout the process. I decided to use Perth Solar force after a professional presentation from Glenn Taylor who fully explained the process and answered all my questions.Installation ran smoothly with the guys punctual on timings. The grid connection went smoothly also.

At first i didn't think solar would save me much but 12 months later i'm surprised the amount we are saving and how low our power bill is, The salesman Glen explained everything clearly to us, The installation was quick and left the area clean Would highly recommend these guysLes
Everything was smooth from the home visit, product information, aerial shots of our property and prompt, efficient installation as well as after sales support.

Very efficient and well-organised company and crew! The sales/quoting process was quick and professional, and all my questions were answered on the spot or quickly followed up via email. Communication was great and with very quick responses. Thank you Nicola Busquets, you've done an amazing job!The installation was scheduled quite quickly and the technicians have done a really nice and clean job with the installation. One of the roof ridge capping cracked during installation, they've sealed it and SolarForce followed up with a roofing company to get this properly fixed and sorted for us.So to sum things us, great customer service, smooth and clean installation and a good working unit!

We found the quoting process helpful, and Perth Solar Force were the only quote we got where a person actually came to our home and looked at our roof and our setup. We really appreciated this, because we have a rooftop air con unit and also cat netting around the entire rear of the property that restricts access to the roof from the rear.The installation was really prompt and hassle-free, and no broken tiles.
